YT updates
Instant push for new builds (UnifiedPush/ntfy)
Tells you about a new build right after it is out, through the ntfy app instead of Google. The push only starts the normal check.
Push status
No push distributor – tap to get ntfy
Distributor found (%1$s), not registered yet – tap to try again
Registration failed – tap to try again
Registered with %1$s
Registered with %1$s – the push address changed: copy it again and replace the GitHub secret
Copy push address
Store it once as the GitHub secret YT_PUSH_URL, then every build reports itself. Keep the address secret.
Push address copied

Next steps (only once):

1. On github.com, open the repository Tra1c0/YT-App.
2. Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → “New repository secret”.
3. Name: YT_PUSH_URL, Secret: paste the copied address, tap “Add secret”.

From the next build on, the notification comes at once. The address works like a key: do not share it.
No push distributor

For the instant push, YT needs a UnifiedPush distributor app, for example ntfy (free, without Google). After installing it, come back here: YT then registers.\n\nOn Xiaomi phones, allow autostart for ntfy and set its battery saver to “No restrictions”, or pushes arrive late.
Get ntfy
Instant push for new builds

With the ntfy app, a new build reports itself at once instead of at the next check. Copy the push address once and store it as the GitHub secret YT_PUSH_URL. Without push, YT checks a few extra times while a build is running.
Settings → Notifications → App updates
Notifications for new videos
Separate from the app updates: own switch, own category “New videos” in Android. Off stops checking the subscriptions completely.
Settings → Notifications → New videos of channels
